description: Systematically isolate, diagnose, and resolve Linux system, storage, memory, performance, and service failures. Use when diagnosing high load, out-of-memory (OOM) crashes, disk space or inode exhaustion, crashing systemd services, network or DNS failures, or intermittent anomalies through reproducible observations. Do not use for Kubernetes or container-orchestrator incidents (cluster-level), application logic bugs, macOS or Windows hosts, or for security incident response and forensics on a possibly compromised host.
